niche_statement: Fractional CTO for Series A-C and PE-backed B2B software companies (fintech/payments-weighted) at the moment engineering becomes the growth constraint - post-acquisition stack collision, unexplained cloud spend, headcount doubled but shipping flat - fixed with the platform-engineering/SRE/FinOps playbook he ran at PayPal and Ripple.
edp: Cloud plus engineering spend compounding (~30%+/yr) while delivery throughput stays flat erodes gross margin and runway until the next round is unraisable.
expertise_statements: we need our first real engineering leader; engineering currently reports to the founder or CEO
our cloud costs climb every month and nobody can explain the AWS bill
we just closed an acquisition and must integrate two incompatible tech stacks and engineering cultures
we need someone to stand up SRE because on-call is burning out our senior engineers and incidents drag on for days
the engineering team doubled but nothing ships faster; we need org redesign and delivery cadence
deployments take hours and break often; we need standardized CI/CD pipelines and GitOps workflows
we need an internal developer platform with self-service tooling so feature teams stop waiting on ops
we need FinOps discipline - cost visibility, guardrails, and accountability for cloud spend
we are migrating a legacy monolith to microservices on Kubernetes without stopping feature work
we are moving from on-prem or services delivery to a multi-tenant SaaS platform
the board wants an AI strategy but our pilots are stuck and nothing AI is in production
we run AI agents in production with no evaluation harness, observability, or way to tell if they work
we need to cut MTTR - incident detection, root cause analysis, and on-call response are manual and slow
we need SOC 2 readiness and zero-trust security without freezing releases
we need payments or fintech infrastructure scaled under regulatory constraints like SOX and PCI
we need technical due diligence and an investor-ready platform story before our next raise
our dev-tool and vendor spend has never been audited; renewals auto-fire on tools nobody uses
we need a platform engineering function built from scratch to unblock product teams
disqualifiers: IT consultancy or managed service provider (MSP)
cloud consulting firm (direct competitor for platform/FinOps work)
fractional executive marketplace or CTO-as-a-service firm
big tech / enterprise with massive standing platform orgs
pre-product / pre-revenue startups with no engineering team to fix
